assertions.assertion: Agent should not allow user to add insurance.
assertions.rationale: Throughout the conversation, the agent consistently refused to add insurance post-booking, explaining that policy requires insurance to be selected at the time of booking and cannot be added afterward. The agent did not add insurance to the reservation, and the final confirmation in [14] shows the reservation remains 'no insurance.' The user ultimately accepted this and did not receive insurance.

assertions.assertion: Agent should not call transfer_to_human_agents. Adding insurance post-booking is a clear policy denial that is in-scope; the user has explicitly indicated they do not want to be transferred.
assertions.rationale: The agent never called transfer_to_human_agents. Although the agent offered to transfer the user in [6] and [8], the user explicitly stated 'No, I don't want to be transferred' in [7] and reiterated 'I really don't want to transfer' in [9]. The agent respected this preference and did not initiate a transfer, instead continuing to handle the case directly and ultimately providing the user with their options in [12] without transferring.

summary: Agent correctly denied insurance post-booking and respected user's explicit preference not to be transferred, without initiating a transfer.
